blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 14 in June to 11 in October (−21.4%), and it took 30.4% of the city’s 46 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 16 in June to 8 in October (−50.0%), and it took 23.4% of the city’s 77 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out South Meadows for detached houses in June, August, September (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in July, October (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in August, September, October (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July (a buyers’ best bet).

items.t: No official boundary is published for the MLS name; working limits only: Hammond Road and the rail line to the north, the Fraser River to the south, the Bonson Road corridor in the middle, and the Golden Ears Business Park lands toward Harris Road to the west; exact east and west limits: Not verified.

Where the attached stock concentrates: Osprey Village and the Fraser Way / Sutton Avenue pocket at the river end of Bonson Road — and it is townhome stock, not apartment condos. The village core is Fraser Way and Barnston View Road, with the South Bonson Community Centre and Pitt Meadows Art Gallery at 10932 Barnston View Road.

Transit: routes 719 and 722 run as a combined circular service through Bonson Road and Fraser Way to Meadowtown, Pitt Meadows Station and Maple Meadows Station; route 701 runs along Hammond Road at the north edge; the West Coast Express runs from Pitt Meadows Station north of the area — no station is in this sub-area.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in South Meadows

items.t: Rental-restriction bylaws are void — and Pitt Meadows separately prohibits short-term rentals city-wide: Since November 24, 2022 (Bill 44), no strata may enforce a long-term rental-restriction bylaw — that voids, in-entry, the Coho II directory line "rentals allowed w/restrictions" in as a restriction. The voiding does not create a short-term-rental right here: short-term rental accommodation is not a permitted use under the City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw — a City staff report to Council (October 23, 2024) states this expressly — and the Province's principal-residence requirement also lists Pitt Meadows.

Flood / dikes: the City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of the Pitt Meadows land base lies within the floodplain for the Fraser River and, to a smaller degree, the Pitt River — that current City figure governs; the guide page's "over 85%" figure is superseded and retired here. The city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes, plus ditches, pump stations and flood boxes; this sub-area sits behind the Fraser River dyke in drainage Area 3 (Kennedy, including McKechnie) of the Pitt Meadows / Maple Ridge Diking District. 78% of the city's land base is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, though the urban South Bonson pocket itself is developed residential / village land.

Property taxes and drainage levy: 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, under the 2026 Annual Tax Rates Bylaw No. 3047, 2026 (adopted May 5, 2026), with a 5% penalty added after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after August 1, 2026. The same bylaw charges a separate residential (Class 1) drainage levy of $0.1082 per $1,000 of taxable value, alongside the general municipal rate of $2.8438 per $1,000.

Suites: one secondary suite per principal dwelling unit (33 to 90 sq m, inside the same building) where the zone permits it; garden suites are one per lot at 33 to 90 sq m in the zones listed in the City garden suite guide, including RS; a lot with a garden suite cannot also have a secondary suite.

blocks.text: Good to know about South Meadows

items.t: The MLS name and the City name are different places on paper. "South Meadows" exists only in the board taxonomy; the City's own name for this pocket is South Bonson. City documents, permits and the community centre all use Bonson — a buyer searching City sources for "South Meadows" will find nothing.

The floodplain figure has a stale twin on the guide page. The City's current figure is over 95% of the land base in the floodplain (2020 Business Plan); the guide page's Planning section quotes a Financial Plan figure of "over 85%", and figures around 85% still circulate. The 95% figure governs.

Two rental rules point in opposite directions here. Provincially, long-term rental caps in strata bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022 — but Pitt Meadows' zoning prohibits short-term rental accommodation outright, city-wide. A buyer underwriting either an Airbnb or a "no rentals allowed" assumption from a directory line gets both wrong.
Part of the guide page could not be read pass.

The dike is the park. Shoreline Park and the dyke-top trails run on the Fraser River dike itself at 51 Bonson Road — the flood-protection structure is the neighbourhood's main recreational asset, which is why dike, drainage and the 15.0 m RS siting setback from watercourses and ditches belong in the same diligence conversation as the view.

The west edge is a business park, not future condos. The Golden Ears Business Park is being built out in phases by Onni Group in the south Bonson / south Harris Road area per City material, and the Pitt Meadows Road and Rail Improvements Project adds a four-lane underpass below the CPKC crossing at Harris Road — employment and construction context for the sub-area's west side, not residential supply.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in South Meadows

items.t: Form B diligence (the pointer complexes are all strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Suites and SSMUH: one secondary suite per principal dwelling unit, 33 to 90 sq m, inside the same building, where the zone permits it; garden suites are one per lot at 33 to 90 sq m in the zones listed in the City garden suite guide, and a lot with a garden suite cannot also have a secondary suite. SSMUH unit counts of 3, 4 or 6 turn on the 280 sq m lot-size threshold and the 400 m frequent-transit test; the City's OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3034, 2025 covers 2–6 units through secondary suites, garden suites, duplexes, triplexes, townhomes and small apartment buildings.

Flood / dikes: sources differ on the share of Pitt Meadows in the floodplain. The City's 2020 Business Plan says over 95%, while the Planning section of the guide page (City Financial Plan 2026–2030) says "over 85%"; confirm the current figure with the City. The city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes, plus ditches, pump stations and flood boxes; this sub-area sits behind the Fraser River dyke in drainage Area 3 (Kennedy, including McKechnie), and Shoreline Park and the dyke-top trails sit on the dike itself. Confirm flood construction level, covenants and insurance for the specific complex.

ALR and airport: the City's 2020 Business Plan states 78% of Pitt Meadows land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve citywide; the urban South Bonson pocket itself is developed residential/village land, and ALR status for a specific parcel at the sub-area's edges is a per-address ALC map check: Not verified at parcel level. Pitt Meadows Regional Airport (YPK) is west of the area across Harris Road; an official airport noise-zone map covering this sub-area is not verified.

The dike is the neighbourhood's front yard — and its flood infrastructure. Shoreline Park at 51 Bonson Road and the dyke-top trails run on the Fraser River dike itself, in drainage Area 3; the recreation is genuine, and the structure underneath it is flood protection first.

Fee-simple lots

items.t: Bonson corridor house lots: detached houses on the Bonson Road corridor and side streets under RS Large Lot Residential, R-3, R-4 and R-6 Urban Residential zones in Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011, with townhome and duplex streets around Osprey Village and along Fraser Way, Bonson Road and Hammond Road.

Lot character from the zones, as stated: RS minimum lot area 0.2 ha; R-3 / R-4 / R-6 each carry a minimum lot area for subdivision of 1,215 sq m — and the 1,215 sq m figure is a subdivision minimum only and does not apply to development on existing lots, per the current bylaw text as clarified by the City's SSMUH implementation update (the newer source governing over the older bylaw reading). RM-1 Multi-Family Residential 1 (townhouse) minimum lot area 0.4 ha; RM-2 minimum lot area 3,035 sq m. Residential buildings are sited at least 15.0 m from watercourses and key or constructed ditches. These are zone figures, not a claim about any existing lot's size.

Servicing position: this sub-area sits behind the Fraser River dyke in drainage Area 3 (Kennedy, including McKechnie) of the Pitt Meadows / Maple Ridge Diking District, the urban development area serviced by ditches, culverts and storm sewers, discharging to the Alouette, Pitt and Fraser Rivers, and the City charges a separate drainage levy. A parcel-level municipal water/sewer vs well/septic statement: Not confirmed — confirm servicing for the specific parcel with the City.

ALR vs non-ALR: the City's 2020 Business Plan states 78% of Pitt Meadows land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve and agriculture remains the predominant land use citywide; the urban South Bonson pocket itself is developed residential / village land, and ALR status for a specific parcel at the sub-area's edges is a per-address check on Agricultural Land Commission maps. No South Meadows-specific ALR percentage is stated.
Flood position: The city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes, plus ditches, pump stations and flood boxes; Shoreline Park and the dyke-top trails sit on the Fraser River dike itself.

items.t: "South Meadows" is not an official City neighbourhood name — the City describes this part of the city as "South Bonson," the Bonson Road corridor south of Hammond Road and the rail tracks to the Fraser River, including the South Bonson Community Centre at Osprey Village. No official boundary is published for the MLS name; rough working limits only: Hammond Road and the CPKC rail line to the north, the Fraser River and its shoreline parks to the south, the Bonson Road corridor in the middle, with the Golden Ears Business Park lands toward Harris Road to the west; exact east and west limits: Not verified.

Civic anchors: South Bonson Community Centre and the Pitt Meadows Art Gallery at 10932 Barnston View Road in Osprey Village; Bonson Park, 11546 Bonson Road; Pitt Meadows Athletic Park, 11431 Bonson Road, beside the Pitt Meadows Arena complex; Shoreline Park, 51 Bonson Road, on the Fraser River; dyke-top trails run along the Fraser River. The city's only library branch is in Central Meadows. Nearest hospital: Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge.

Schools: SD42 (Maple Ridge–Pitt Meadows) catchments are address-based, with no middle-school tier (K–7 / 8–12). Pitt Meadows Secondary, 19438 116B Avenue, is the only public secondary school in Pitt Meadows.

Market context, labelled correctly: Pitt Meadows is a SnapStats-covered community, and SnapStats has no land category. September 2026 context only, never land figures: South Meadows sub-area detached inventory 11 / solds 5 (45% ratio) and "Condos & Townhomes" combined 13 / 3 (23% ratio); Pitt Meadows community detached median $1,160,000 and condos & townhomes median $662,500. Sub-area medians are not verified (community level only).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in South Meadows

items.t: Zoning — Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011: RS Large Lot Residential, R-3, R-4 and R-6 Urban Residential zones for house lots (minimums), RM-1 / RM-2 for townhouse and low-density apartment sites; residential buildings sited at least 15.0 m from watercourses and key or constructed ditches. Confirm the parcel's zone in the consolidated bylaw.

SSMUH / suites as the City states it: under provincial rules applied citywide, lots 280 sq m or less allow up to 3 units, lots over 280 sq m up to 4 units, and lots over 280 sq m within 400 m of a frequent transit bus stop up to 6 units; the City's SSMUH Zoning Amendment Bylaw No. 2986 was adopted June 25, 2024, and OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3034, 2025 covers 2–6 units through secondary suites, garden suites, duplexes, triplexes, townhomes and small apartment buildings. Suites: one secondary suite per principal dwelling unit, 33 to 90 sq m, inside the same building, where the zone permits it; garden suites are one per lot at 33 to 90 sq m in the zones listed in the City garden suite guide, including RS — and a lot with a garden suite cannot also have a secondary suite. Short-term rentals are prohibited in Pitt Meadows.

Floodplain / drainage diligence: over 95% of the city is in the floodplain, behind 60 km of dikes in drainage Area 3 for this sub-area. Pitt Meadows charges a separate drainage levy inside Bylaw No. 3047, 2026 — for 2026 the residential (Class 1) drainage rate is $0.1082 per $1,000 of taxable value, alongside the general municipal rate of $2.8438 per $1,000. Budget the levy as its own line and confirm floodplain, dike and drainage details for the specific lot with the City.

ALR rules (citywide frame — 78% of Pitt Meadows is ALR; per-parcel check at this sub-area's edges): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error.

Pitt Meadows property taxes: 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, under the 2026 Annual Tax Rates Bylaw No. 3047, 2026 (adopted May 5, 2026), with a 5% penalty added after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after August 1, 2026. A 2026 flat utility fee amount for this area confirmed on a City source: Not verified.

blocks.text: South Meadows, Pitt Meadows: streets and boundaries

items.t: South Meadows is the board name for the South Bonson end of Bonson Road, and the City publishes no boundary for the sub-area.
The working scope is Bonson Road south of Hammond Road and the Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC) rail line, down to the Fraser River, including Fraser Way and Barnston View Road.
The City itself calls this ground South Bonson: its community centre and art gallery are the South Bonson Community Centre at 10932 Barnston View Road.
Mid Meadows and Osprey Village are north, Central Meadows is northwest across Harris Road, and Maple Ridge is east.

blocks.text: South Meadows, Pitt Meadows: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is detached houses on Bonson Road streets plus strata townhomes and duplexes in the Osprey Village and Fraser Way pocket.
Nature's Walk by Onni Group is the named complex here: three- and four-bedroom townhomes and duplexes in South Bonson near Osprey Village, on Sutton Avenue.

House zones under Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 include RS Large Lot Residential and R-3, R-4 and R-6 Urban Residential, with RM-1 townhouse sites at a 0.4 hectare minimum lot area. Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 - Consolidated Version_0.pdf

blocks.text: South Meadows, Pitt Meadows: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Short-term rentals are prohibited in Pitt Meadows: short-term rental accommodation is not a permitted use in the Zoning Bylaw.
A lot here can have one secondary suite at 33 to 90 square metres inside the house, or one garden suite at 33 to 90 square metres where the zone lists it, but never both on one lot.
Residential buildings in the RS zone must be sited at least 15.0 metres from watercourses and key or constructed ditches. Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 - Consolidated Version_0.pdf

blocks.text: South Meadows, Pitt Meadows: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Shoreline Park at 51 Bonson Road is on the Fraser River dike, so the dike top is the neighbourhood's riverfront trail.
Bonson Park at 11546 Bonson Road contains a disc golf course, a use few buyers expect inside a residential pocket.
Pitt Meadows Athletic Park is at 11431 Bonson Road, next to the arena complex with three sheets of ice.
Osprey Village at Fraser Way and Barnston View Road is the local commercial pocket, with the larger Meadowtown centre at 19800 Lougheed Highway north of the rail line.
Route 719 runs Meadowtown to Fraser Way via Hammond Road, Bonson Road and Fraser Way to the Barnston View roundabout, then continues as route 722.
The city's only library branch is north in Central Meadows at 200-12099 Harris Road, not in South Meadows.
Drainage Area 3, which includes South Meadows, is the city's urban drainage area, serviced by ditches, culverts and storm sewers together.

blocks.text: South Meadows, Pitt Meadows: development and new projects

items.t: Pitt Meadows Road and Rail Improvements Project, Harris Road at the CPKC main line — port authority, City and CPKC project, in design and funding correspondence in 2025–2026: a new four-lane underpass below the rail crossing at Harris Road, the north gate to South Meadows (status read November 3, 2026).
The Kennedy Road two-lane overpass in the same project is paused, with priority given to the Harris Road underpass.

blocks.text: South Meadows, Pitt Meadows: costs and taxes

items.t: Pitt Meadows' 2026 general residential rate is $2.8438 per $1,000, plus a separate residential drainage rate of $0.1082 per $1,000, under Annual Tax Rates Bylaw No. 3047, 2026.

blocks.text: South Meadows, Pitt Meadows: getting around

items.t: No West Coast Express station sits in South Meadows; Pitt Meadows Station at 12280 Harris Road, north of the rail line, is the city's station.
Routes 719 and 722 form the Bonson Road loop: 719 runs via Bonson Road and Fraser Way, and 722 returns via Harris Road, Ford Road and Hammond Road.
Harris Road is the main north-south road out of the pocket, and its at-grade CPKC crossing is the delay point the underpass project targets.
Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) and Golden Ears Way run along the city's north side, linking the area to Maple Ridge and the Golden Ears Bridge.

blocks.text: South Meadows, Pitt Meadows: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check floodplain, dike and drainage detail for the exact lot with the City, because the pocket is low land behind the Fraser River dike in drainage Area 3 (Kennedy, including McKechnie).
Check the 15.0 metre RS siting setback from watercourses and key or constructed ditches before planning any addition near a ditch. Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 - Consolidated Version_0.pdf
Check rail noise and crossing delay on streets near the CPKC line and Harris Road; the City's rail page, not a listing, is the source for blockage times.
Check Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) status at the pocket's edges parcel by parcel, because 78% of the city's land base is in the ALR city-wide.

The sub-area's 13 condos & townhomes listings in September 2026 are townhome product — Nature's Walk, Coho II, Shoreline and similar complexes around Osprey Village — and no apartment building name was confirmed on an official, developer or strata source. Buyers who need a low-rise apartment are looking at Central Meadows stock instead.
faq.q: Are there any apartment condos in South Meadows?

faq.a: No. Short-term rental accommodation is not a permitted use under the City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw — prohibited city-wide by the City layer, separate from strata bylaws — and the provincial principal-residence requirement also applies in Pitt Meadows. A strata's silence on short-term rentals does not make the use legal.
faq.q: Can I Airbnb a townhome in Osprey Village?

faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, so directory lines like Coho II's "rentals allowed w/restrictions" do not create an enforceable long-term cap. Long-term renting is the City's permitted residential use; short-term is the prohibited one — keep the two layers separate.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Nature's Walk or Coho II home long-term?

faq.q: Can I run a short-term rental in South Meadows?

faq.a: Only if the pair was legally split — as a 2-lot strata plan or by fee-simple subdivision. A duplex-form unit inside a larger townhouse strata (the Nature's Walk form) is bought as a strata lot in that complex, with Form B diligence for that complex — it is not a 2-lot half duplex. No named 2-lot or fee-simple half is verified here.
faq.q: Can I buy half a duplex in South Meadows?

faq.a: Duplexes are expressly among the 2–6-unit forms covered by the City's OCP Amendment Bylaw No. A secondary suite (33–90 sq m, inside the same building) and a garden suite (33–90 sq m) are alternatives — never both on one lot. Confirm the parcel's zone with the City first.
faq.q: Can a South Meadows house become a duplex or add a suite?

Confirm floodplain, dike and drainage details — including the 15.0 m RS siting setback from watercourses and ditches — for the specific lot with the City.
